description: This file provides polyfills and utility functions for Python builtins and Torch tensors within the PyTorch _dynamo module. It includes class definitions, functions for collections, tensor operations, comparison, and tensor grouping, serving as foundational support code for dynamic graph manipulation and other internal functionalities.

classes.name: NoEnterTorchFunctionMode
classes.description: A class that inherits from BaseTorchFunctionMode, overriding __enter__ to do nothing, serving as a support class for torch function modes with no enter logic.

methods.name: int index( iterator: Iterator[T], item: T, start: int = 0, end: int | None = None )
methods.description: Finds the index of an item in an iterator starting from a specified start position, raising ValueError if not found.

methods.name: Iterator[T] repeat(item: T, count: int)
methods.description: Yields an item repeatedly for a specified number of times.

methods.name: float radians(x: float)
methods.description: Converts an angle from degrees to radians.

methods.name: bool impl_CONTAINS_OP_fallback(a: T, b: Iterable[T])
methods.description: Performs a fallback containment check ('a in b') with type checking and iteration.

methods.name: None accumulate_grad(x: torch.Tensor, new_grad: torch.Tensor | None)
methods.description: Polyfill for accumulating gradients in a torch.Tensor, ensuring proper copying and addition.

methods.name: bool list_cmp( op: Callable[[Any, Any], bool], left: Sequence[T], right: Sequence[T] )
methods.description: Emulates comparison operations on lists, e.g., list greater than, equal, etc.

methods.name: bool dict___eq__(d: dict[T, U], other: dict[T, U])
methods.description: Checks equality of two dictionaries with special handling for OrderedDict.

methods.name: Any set_symmetric_difference( set1: Iterable[T], set2: Iterable[T], cls: type[Any] = set, )
methods.description: Computes the symmetric difference between two iterables, returning a set or specified class.

methods.name: None set_symmetric_difference_update(set1: set[T], set2: set[T])
methods.description: Updates a set to its symmetric difference with another set.

methods.name: bool set_isdisjoint(set1: set[T], set2: set[T])
methods.description: Checks if two sets are disjoint, raising error if the second is not an iterable.

methods.name: Any set_intersection( set1: set[T], *others: Iterable[T], cls: type[Any] = set, )
methods.description: Returns the intersection of multiple sets.

methods.name: None set_intersection_update(set1: set[T], *others: Iterable[T])
methods.description: Updates a set with the intersection of itself and other sets.

methods.name: C|set[T] set_union( set1: set[T], *others: Iterable[T], cls: type[C] | None = None )
methods.description: Returns the union of sets, supporting custom class output.

methods.name: set[T] set_update(set1: set[T], *others: Iterable[T])
methods.description: Updates a set with elements from other iterables.

methods.name: Any set_difference( set1: set[T], *others: Iterable[T], cls: type[Any] = set, )
methods.description: Returns the difference between sets.

methods.name: None set_difference_update(set1: set[T], *others: Iterable[T])
methods.description: Updates a set with the difference of itself and other iterables.

methods.name: None assert_multi_line_equal( self_: Any, first: T, second: T, msg: str | None = None )

methods.name: Any getattr_and_trace(*args: Any, **kwargs: Any)

methods.name: bool cmp_le(a: Any, b: Any)
methods.description: Checks less-than or equal, using __le__ if overridden.

methods.name: bool cmp_gt(a: Any, b: Any)

methods.name: bool cmp_ge(a: Any, b: Any)
methods.description: Checks greater-than or equal, using __ge__ if overridden.
